title_block.title: Matrix acceptance sign-off
title_block.subtitle: Bioanalytical QA, signed copy
lines: Prepared by: Helen Marchwood, Bioanalytical Quality Manager

blocks.p: This sign-off records review responsibilities for tandem-MS matrix acceptance. File it with the current assay worksheet template and apply the acceptance criteria in the analyte-specific method.

Each run carries a calibration curve prepared in the matrix of the study samples. The regression model and weighting are those specified in the analyte-specific method. Back-calculated calibrator concentrations, permitted exclusions and the remaining curve must meet that method’s acceptance criteria before sample concentrations are released.

rows: Investigate the failure; any permitted exclusion and refit is documented, and the remaining curve must meet method acceptance criteria
Matrix blanks and sequence blanks at method-defined positions
Hold affected results while investigating interference or carry-over; apply the method acceptance criteria
Investigate the response and sample preparation; reanalyse where justified and document the decision
Start, middle and end of each batch
Batch rejected and repeated if the run-level QC fails
table.caption: Table 1 Calibration and matrix checks applied to each run

blocks.p: Precursor-to-product ion transitions are confirmed against the reference standard before a new analyte card is opened. Where a qualifier transition is part of the method, a response ratio outside its tolerance triggers investigation of identity, interference and integration. Affected results remain on hold until the discrepancy is resolved and documented; the quantitation transition alone does not override the identity check.

The analyst prepares the batch and completes the first review. A second scientist, not involved in the run, checks the calibration, QC and internal standard data before the batch is released to the study director.

list: Analyst: batch preparation, first review, worksheet entries
Second reviewer: independent check of calibration and QC, signed on the worksheet
Mass-spectrometry manager: instrument status and any tuning changes
Study director: release of data to the study report, after matrix acceptance is recorded

blocks.p: Reviews are signed and dated on the worksheet in ink. Electronic reviews are accepted only where the LIMS audit trail is available for the same run.

The assay worksheet must identify the control preparation and its source lot references, matching the preparation record and storage log. Qualification of a replacement control preparation follows the analyte-specific method; the reviewer checks that record before the preparation is used for run acceptance.
Correction to the control lot reference in the draft of this sign-off has been made by hand on the signed copy and is initialled below.
